JPEG decoder from jpeg-js 0.4.4, copied byte-for-byte from lib/decoder.js (only filename extension changed to .cjs). The Edge runtime and host integration use this same bounded decoder, so there is no runtime package download requirement. Source: https://github.com/jpeg-js/jpeg-js/tree/v0.4.4 . The backend development lockfile pins the package for reproducible provenance. Retain its BSD licence and the decoder's Apache 2.0 notices/full licence. This third-party code is not covered by Sicy's proprietary source licence. Strict decode uses maxResolutionInMP=3, maxMemoryUsageInMB=32, useTArray=true and tolerantDecoding=false; structural checks additionally cap JPEG bytes/dimensions and reject EXIF. Review upstream security updates before pilot release.
